datasets.name: In-house cine
datasets.description: The current in-house cardiac cine dataset used in MRBench's published acceleration and sampling experiments. Benchmark measurements are constructed from prepared complex reference images and sensitivity maps.
datasets.context: Only anonymized quantitative endpoints are published for this cohort. Source data and private participant information are not distributed through the dashboard.

datasets.name: CMRxRecon
datasets.description: CMRxRecon provides public cardiac MRI k-space datasets and reconstruction challenges for the research community.
datasets.context: CMRxRecon is a planned dataset extension in MRBench. The results currently published here use the in-house cine cohort; no CMRxRecon cohort results are included.

datasets.name: Additional data / fastMRI
datasets.description: MRBench is designed to extend to additional MRI datasets, including fastMRI, an external MRI dataset and research initiative.
datasets.context: The framework includes an input-preparation path for selected static multi-coil brain and knee data. This does not establish validation for every fastMRI format or model combination. No fastMRI cohort results are published in this dashboard.

models.name: RAM
models.description: A lightweight, non-iterative reconstruction model that incorporates acquisition physics to address a range of imaging inverse problems, including MRI.
models.attribution: Original work by Matthieu Terris, Samuel Hurault, Maxime Song and Julian Tachella.
models.context: The published MRBench cohort uses the DeepInv implementation of RAM. Its MRI adapter receives multi-coil measurements, a physical mask and complex sensitivity maps.
models.paper_title: Reconstruct Anything Model: a lightweight general model for computational imaging

models.name: SDUM
models.description: An MRI reconstruction framework combining cascaded unrolled reconstruction, learned coil sensitivity estimation and acquisition-aware data consistency and conditioning.
models.attribution: Original work by Puyang Wang, Pengfei Guo, Keyi Chai, Jinyuan Zhou, Daguang Xu and Shanshan Jiang.
models.context: The published MRBench cohort evaluates SDUM Base. The adapter preserves the released temporal-window inference and internal sensitivity-map estimation. The official implementation is distributed as NV-Raw2Insights-MRI.
models.paper_title: SDUM: A Scalable Deep Unrolled Model for Universal MRI Reconstruction

models.name: CardioMM
models.description: A generalist model for accelerated cardiovascular MRI reconstruction that combines semantic acquisition context with physics-informed data consistency.
models.attribution: Original work by Zi Wang and colleagues.
models.context: MRBench uses a pinned official source implementation with framewise inference, internal sensitivity-map estimation and acquisition-metadata conditioning.
models.paper_title: Enabling Ultra-Fast Cardiovascular Imaging Across Heterogeneous Clinical Environments with A Generalist Foundation Model and Multimodal Database
